name: SDF-based Neural Fields
definition: A representation combining NeRF with Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) to provide a more explicit and smooth formulation of surfaces, addressing the geometric inaccuracy and surface holes typical of density-based NeRFs.
summary: SDF-based Neural Fields replace standard NeRF density with Signed Distance Functions to define geometry via zero-level sets, offering explicit, smooth surfaces that fix density-based inaccuracies and holes.
